consent.title: Sign in to MathTrail
consent.heading: Connect {client} to MathTrail?
consent.return: After you sign in, you will be sent back to {address}.
consent.loopback: That address is on this computer. MathTrail cannot check which app is waiting there: continue only if you started it yourself.
consent.google: Google will then ask you to sign in. On its screen, tick the box for Google Drive: MathTrail keeps one file of its own there, where your child's progress is saved, and sees no other file.
consent.legal: By allowing, you accept MathTrail's {terms} and {privacy}.
consent.reviewer_text: Sign in with the reviewer's password from the review form, in place of Google. It opens the demo profile kept for review.
drive.heading: Tick the box for Google Drive
drive.text: On Google's screen, the box that lets MathTrail keep its file in your Google Drive was left unticked. That one file is where your child's progress is saved, so MathTrail cannot work without it. It sees no other file in your Drive.
drive.box: Press “Back to Google” and tick the box about your Google Drive files. Google words it in your account's language; in English it reads “See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app”.
refusal.request.heading: This sign-in link is not right
refusal.request.text: The app that sent you here asked for a sign-in in a way MathTrail does not accept. Go back to the app and connect again; if it happens again, the app needs fixing.
refusal.client.heading: MathTrail does not know this app
refusal.client.text: The app that sent you here could not be identified, so the sign-in stops here. Go back to the app and connect again.
refusal.redirect.heading: This app asked to send you somewhere unexpected
refusal.redirect.text: After a sign-in MathTrail sends you back only to an address the app named in advance, and this one is not among them. For your safety, the sign-in stops here.
refusal.expired.heading: The sign-in took too long
refusal.expired.text: A sign-in has to be finished within ten minutes. Go back to the app and connect again.
refusal.cookie.heading: The sign-in has to finish where it started
refusal.cookie.text: Your browser did not bring back the cookie this sign-in started with: cookies may be blocked for this site, or the sign-in was started again in another tab. Allow cookies, go back to the app and connect again.
refusal.unconfigured.heading: Signing in is not set up here
refusal.unconfigured.text: This copy of MathTrail has no Google sign-in configured, so nobody can sign in to it.
refusal.failed.heading: Something went wrong on our side
refusal.failed.text: The sign-in could not be finished. Wait a minute, go back to the app and connect again.
refusal.password.heading: That is not the reviewer's password
refusal.password.text: Go back and type the password exactly as the review form gives it. Parents need no password: they sign in with Google.
refusal.busy.heading: Too many sign-ins at once
refusal.busy.text: More requests came from your network in a short time than MathTrail takes. Wait a minute, go back to the app and connect again.
